title: Hearty Tunisian Tortilla Wrap
description: A mustardy and tender Tunisian dish featuring flour tortilla, beurre-monte, and raw-friendly ingredients, perfect for a satisfying lunch or snack.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together beurre-monte and Dijon mustard until smooth.
Spread a tablespoon of the beurre-monte mixture onto each tortilla.
Top each tortilla with a quarter cup of hummus, leaving a small border around the edges.
Arrange chopped cucumber, bell pepper, and parsley on top of the hummus.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Fold the bottom edge of each tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up to form a tight wrap.
Place the wraps in the skillet, seam-side down, and cook for 2-3 minutes or until lightly browned.
Flip the wraps over and cook for an additional 2 minutes or until crispy and golden.
